Definition: to gaze upon; mentally to dream, be usual (i.e. seem)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to see, behold; 1a)(P'al); 1a1) to see; 1a2) to see, behold, witness; 1a3) to behold (in a dream or vision); 1a4) customary, seemly (passive)
